name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted web desktop with a file system, built-in apps and a developer API, backed by SQLite and S3-compatible object storage.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the temporary password printed in the puter container logs (search for "password for admin"), then change it in Settings.
Anyone who opens the site can create an account and store files. For a private instance, add "disable_user_signup": true to the generated config.json mount and redeploy.

The API is served on api.<your domain> and browser file transfers on s3.<your domain>; both subdomains must resolve to this server. If you change the domain, update it in the generated config.json mount as well.
